_note: Seed make/model reference for CTA-2063-A Remote ID serials. Keyed by the 4-char manufacturer code that opens every compliant serial. Make-level entries (manufacturer only) are reliable; model-level entries require a serial_prefix that pins a specific product. This seed is intentionally small and verified; expand it with the System > Refresh button (pulls the FAA Declaration of Compliance list) or by importing a CSV. Codes exclude the letters I and O per the standard.

entries.note: DJI's assigned CTA-2063-A manufacturer code; covers the large majority of consumer drones in the field.
